arxiv-1901-03092.title: A possible experimental test of the nonlinear phononics interpretation of light-induced superconductivity
arxiv-1901-03092.creator: M. Altarelli
arxiv-1901-03092.description: Abstract Experimental evidence for a transient enhancement of the superconducting critical temperature in presence of an intense THz or IR pump pulse was ascribed to nonlinear phononics effects. Here I introduce a simple phenomenological Ginzburg-Landau model of this phenomenon, to explore further consequences and possible experimental tests of this interpretation.

arxiv-2011-05592.title: Phase transitions in the one-dimensional ionic Hubbard model
arxiv-2011-05592.creator: Myung-Hoon Chung
arxiv-2011-05592.description: Abstract We study quantum phase transitions by measuring the bond energy, the number density, and the half-chain entanglement entropy in the one-dimensional ionic Hubbard model. By performing the infinite density matrix renormalization group with matrix product operator, we obtain ground states as the canonical form of matrix product states.

arxiv-2105-08661.title: On abelian ℓ \ell -towers of multigraphs II
arxiv-2105-08661.creator: Kevin McGown, Daniel Vallières
arxiv-2105-08661.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Kevin McGown, Daniel Vallières. Let ℓ \ell be a rational prime. Previously, abelian ℓ \ell -towers of multigraphs were introduced which are analogous to ℤ ℓ \mathbb{Z}_{\ell} -extensions of number fields. It was shown that for a certain class of towers of bouquets, the growth of the ℓ \ell -part of the number of spanning trees behaves in a predictable manner (analogous to a well-known theorem of Iwasawa for ℤ ℓ \mathbb{Z}_{\ell} -extensions of number fields).

arxiv-2207-05476.title: VertXNet: Automatic Segmentation and Identification of Lumbar and Cervical Vertebrae from Spinal X-ray Images
arxiv-2207-05476.creator: Yao Chen ∗ Yuanhan Mo ∗ Aimee Readie Gregory Ligozio, Thibaud Coroller † Bartłomiej W. Papież †
arxiv-2207-05476.description: Abstract Manual annotation of vertebrae on spinal X-ray imaging is costly and time-consuming due to bone shape complexity and image quality variations. In this study, we address this challenge by proposing an ensemble method called VertXNet, to automatically segment and label vertebrae in X-ray spinal images.

arxiv-2403-11826.title: Integrating Physics Inspired Features with Graph Convolution
arxiv-2403-11826.creator: Rameswar Sahu ID
arxiv-2403-11826.description: Abstract With the advent of advanced machine learning techniques, boosted object tagging has witnessed significant progress. In this article, we take this field further by introducing novel architectural modifications compatible with a wide array of Graph Neural Network (GNN) architectures. Our approach advocates for integrating capsule layers, replacing the conventional decoding blocks in standard GNNs.

arxiv-2502-15596.title: Projective imaging of high-energy nuclei through coherent exclusive vector meson production in electron-ion collisions
arxiv-2502-15596.creator: Maci Kesler 1 , Ashik Ikbal Sheikh 1 , Rongrong Ma 2 , Zhoudunming Tu 2 , Thomas Ullrich 2 , Zhangbu Xu 1,2
arxiv-2502-15596.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Maci Kesler 1 , Ashik Ikbal Sheikh 1 , Rongrong Ma 2 , Zhoudunming Tu 2 , Thomas Ullrich 2 , Zhangbu Xu 1,2. One of the major goals of the Electron-Ion Collider (EIC) is to study the distributions of gluons inside nuclei at high energy.

arxiv-2503-15885.title: Human or LLM? A Comparative Study on Accessible Code Generation Capability
arxiv-2503-15885.creator: Hyunjae Suh, Mahan Tafreshipour, Sam Malek, Iftekhar Ahmed
arxiv-2503-15885.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hyunjae Suh, Mahan Tafreshipour, Sam Malek, Iftekhar Ahmed. Web accessibility is essential for inclusive digital experiences, yet the accessibility of LLM-generated code remains underexplored. This paper presents an empirical study comparing the accessibility of web code generated by GPT-4o and Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct-AWQ against human-written code. Results show that LLMs often produce more accessible code, especially for basic features like color contrast and alternative text, but struggle with complex issues such as ARIA attributes.

pmc-10673067.title: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Campylobacter Species Contamination in Poultry, Meat, and Processing Environments in South Korea
pmc-10673067.creator: Hyeon Ji Je, Saloni Singh, Dong Woo Kim, Hyun Seok Hur, Ah Leum Kim, Eun Jin Seo, Ok Kyung Koo, Rijkelt Beumer
pmc-10673067.description: Campylobacter spp. constitute a significant global threat as a leading cause of foodborne illnesses, with poultry meat as a prominent reservoir for these pathogens. South Korea is known for its diverse poultry consumption habits, and continuous outbreaks make it a matter of concern to perform a meta-analysis to identify the primary source of contamination.

pmc-11439277.title: Attitudes toward driving after cannabis use: a systematic review
pmc-11439277.creator: Bianca Boicu, Durr Al-Hakim, Yue Yuan, Jeffrey Brubacher
pmc-11439277.description: BackgroundDriving after cannabis use (DACU) is associated with increased risk of motor vehicle collisions. As cannabis legalization expands, DACU is emerging as a major public safety concern. Attitudes have a significant impact on behavioural decision making. As such, understanding the degree to which people have favorable or unfavorable evaluations of DACU is an important first step for informing prevention efforts.

pmc-11823537.title: Comparison of Corneal Tomography Parameters in the Diagnosis of Keratoconus in Early and Late Pediatric Age Group
pmc-11823537.creator: Seray Sahin, Melis Palamar, Sait Egrilmez, Ayse Yagci, Ozlem Barut Selver
pmc-11823537.description: PURPOSE:The purpose of this study was to examine demographic and tomographic parameters in pediatric patients diagnosed with keratoconus and to evaluate the difference between early and late age periods.METHODS:This retrospective study included patients younger than 18 years of age who were diagnosed with keratoconus. All examination findings, demographic data, tomography parameters, and keratoconus stages were recorded.

pmc-12516982.title: Expansion of a circulating Ki67-positive effector T-cell population following combined PD-1 and CTLA-4 blockade for melanoma is predictive of treatment response
pmc-12516982.creator: Jack M Edwards, Sashendra Senthi, Robin Smith, Hayley Burridge, Carole Owens, Mark Shackleton, Miles C Andrews, Menno C van Zelm
pmc-12516982.description: BackgroundDespite the success of combined cytotoxic T-lymphocyte associated protein 4 (CTLA-4) and programmed cell death protein-1 (PD-1) immune checkpoint blockade (cICB), the majority of patients with melanoma fail to respond or experience severe treatment-related toxicity. Currently, there are no reliable biomarkers available to predict these events and guide treatment choices.

pmc-13377834.title: Combining arthroscopic microfracture, autologous bone grafting, and PRP injection for the treatment of Hepple IV-V stage osteochondral lesions of talus
pmc-13377834.creator: Hao Han, Qi Lu, Long Yang, Yaozhou Shi, Yuehua Hui, Rongjian Shi, Qinwei Guo, Jie Li, Guangchao Cao
pmc-13377834.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeThe purpose of this study was to evaluate the clinical and radiological outcomes of arthroscopic autologous cancellous bone grafting combined with platelet-rich plasma (PRP) injection in patients with osteochondral lesions of talus (OLT).Methods This retrospective study was conducted at Xuzhou Renci Hospital from January 2020 to June 2023, including patients was diagnosed with Hepple stage IV or V OLT by magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). All patients underwent arthroscopic debridement and microfracture, autologous cancellous bone grafting, and PRP injection.

pmc-13408125.title: Single-layer compact dual-band dual-circularly polarized antenna based on proximity-coupling feed patches
pmc-13408125.creator: Hung Tran-Huy, Hien Nguyen-Thi, Hung Nguyen-Manh, Muhammad Ikram
pmc-13408125.description: This paper presents a single-layer compact antenna with capability of realizing dual-sense circularly polarized (CP) radiation at two distinct frequency bands. The design employs multiple truncated-corner patches of different sizes operating in their fundamental modes, which are proximity-coupled through a probe-fed microstrip line. This configuration enables a single-layer structure, compact footprint, and flexible frequency-ratio tuning.
